improvements.rationale: A clear meta description improves click-through rates from search results by communicating the core value proposition and pricing upfront. Open Graph tags ensure professional, branded previews when the homepage is shared on LinkedIn, Twitter, or Facebook—critical for B2B audiences. Including the free trial and low entry price creates urgency without overpromising.

improvements.suggestion:
Hero Headline: "Your AI Trade & Business Assistant — Powered by Claude"

Subheading: "Meet Gideon. Get instant answers, voice chat, and professional support for trade and operations. Try 3 free searches — no card required."
improvements.rationale: This headline immediately establishes what Gideon is (AI assistant) and its credibility (Claude-powered). The subheading hits three key value props quickly, then removes friction by highlighting the free trial with no payment commitment. The structure follows proven SaaS conversion patterns: identity → benefits → low-risk CTA.

improvements.suggestion:
Q: What happens after my three free searches?

A: Once you've used your three complimentary searches, you'll be invited to become a member to continue accessing Gideon. Membership starts at just US$2 per day, billed monthly—or save 30 percent with an annual plan. As a member, you unlock unlimited access to Gideon's AI-powered workspace, voice chat, and professional trade and business support.
improvements.rationale: This FAQ directly addresses the most common friction point in the user journey—the transition from free trial to paid membership. It transparently explains the paywall, reinforces value with specific pricing, and highlights the annual savings incentive, helping convert trial users into paying members.
